text: HardDeleteDetachedMessage silently attaches a detached header, requires its store token, checks DeleteStoreMessages, then deletes the database header without immediate commit. Later errors do not roll back attachment. MoveIncorporatedMessage logs source-cleanup failure without replacing its successful destination-copy result. Mbox cleanup marks status for later compaction and its API permits no-op success; the selected maildir implementation does not check Remove's result. These paths do not establish physical deletion or all-or-nothing state from an NS_OK move.
title: Detached POP cleanup has ordered failure boundaries rather than a transaction
